    About this Item

    • Seamless Performance: Enjoy smooth streaming, gaming, and browsing with 4GB RAM and 64GB storage—built for all-day entertainment on the go.
    • AI-Enhanced Cameras: Capture every moment with a 13MP AI rear camera and crystal-clear 5MP front camera for stunning selfies.
    • Long-Lasting Power: Stay powered all day with a 5000mAh battery and quick 10W Type-C charging for hassle-free use.
    • Immersive Display: Dive into vibrant visuals on a 6.75" HD+ screen with a fluid 90Hz refresh rate for a bold, smooth viewing experience.
    • Built for Life: Designed for everyday durability with IP64-rated protection from dust and accidental splashes.

    Product description

    Lava Bold N2 delivers smooth everyday performance with a large 6.75-inch HD+ display and a 90Hz refresh rate. Powered by an octa-core Unisoc processor and Android 15 Go, it ensures efficient multitasking. The 5000mAh battery supports all-day usage, while features like a 13MP rear camera, side fingerprint sensor, Type-C charging, and IP64 dust and water resistance add durability and convenience for daily use.
